# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_deployment (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_deployment" "example_zero_trust_cws_deployment" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  deployment_id = "182bd5e5-6e1a-4fe4-a799-aa6d9a6ab26e"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)

### Optional

- `deployment_id` (String) ID of the deployment to retrieve
- `filter` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))

### Read-Only

- `basic_auth_credential_ids` (Set of String) IDs of basic-auth credentials attached to this deployment
- `created_at` (String)
- `default_mode` (String) Default traffic decision when no policy set matches
Available values: "ALLOW", "BLOCK".
- `description` (String) Optional free-form description.
- `domain_acl_id` (String) ID of the attached domain ACL. Omitted when none.
- `id` (String) ID of the deployment to retrieve
- `name` (String) Human-readable name; unique per account
- `on_error_action` (String) Action applied when an enforcing policy has a runtime Rego error
Available values: "BLOCK", "SKIP".
- `policy_set_ids` (Set of String) IDs of policy sets attached to this deployment
- `rego_raise_error` (Boolean) Whether OPA builtin failures are raised as runtime evaluation errors
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags attached to this deployment
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `direction` (String) Sort direction (default: asc)
Available values: "asc", "desc".
- `name` (String) Filter by deployment name (case-insensitive substring match)
- `order` (String) Field to order results by (default: created_at)
Available values: "name", "created_at", "updated_at".
